out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. OBSERVED NO 2026 HEALTH PERMIT POSTED.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH HAND SINKS WITH A MAXIMUM HOT WATER TEMPERATURE OF 85F (BACK HAND SINK) AND 86F (FRONT HAND SINK).
violations.corrective_action: CONTACT A LICENSED PLUMBER TO ADJUST VALVE SO HOT WATER IS A MINIMUM 100F AT BOTH HAND SINKS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF CLEANING SOLUTION HANGING NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH SANITIZER NAME..

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SUGAR, FLOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELLED CONTAINERS WITH FOOD NAME.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED STRONG ODOR COMING FROM GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CONTACT A LICENSED COMPANY TO CLEAN GREAST TRAP AT A FREQUENCY REQUIRED BY FOOD PRODUCTION/WASTE. PROVIDE INVOICE OF CLEANING TO EHS WITHIN 90 DAYS.
